alt: Eight atoms in a 2 by 2 by 2 cubic cell, C-type antiferromagnetic: neighbours in a layer alternate, layers stack the same way. Up arrows have a solid head and a plus sign, down arrows an open head and a minus sign.
caption: Toy model, hand-set signs: C-type antiferromagnetic: neighbours in a layer alternate, layers stack the same way. Moments are drawn as unit arrows, not computed values.
